title: Air-fryer halloumi fries
subtitle: Halloumi fingers air-fried until golden and squeaky.
excerpt: Halloumi cut into thick fingers and air-fried without oil until the outside is golden and slightly charred and the inside is hot and firm. Ready in 10 minutes. Serves two as a starter or side.
sourceNotes: Halloumi is a Cypriot semi-hard cheese made from a mixture of goat and sheep milk. Its high melting point makes it suitable for grilling and frying. The air fryer produces a good char on the exterior without the mess of a frying pan and without added oil, as halloumi has enough fat to cook itself.

content.text: Halloumi fries need no added oil in the air fryer ,  the cheese has enough fat to crisp its own surface. Cut into fingers about 1.5 cm wide for the best ratio of crisp exterior to warm interior. Eat immediately: halloumi fries firm up and lose their freshness within a few minutes of coming out of the fryer.

items.prepNote: drained and patted dry, cut into 1.5 cm thick fingers

content.text: Pat the {{halloumi}} fingers completely dry with paper towel. Preheat the air fryer to 200°C. Place the halloumi fingers in the basket in a single layer without oil. Cook for 5 minutes, flip with tongs, and cook for a further 4-5 minutes until golden and slightly charred on both sides. Serve immediately with lemon wedges if using.

items.cause: Basket too cold, or halloumi still wet.
items.fix: Preheat fully and pat dry. If sticking is an issue, a very light spray of cooking oil on the basket before adding the halloumi will help.

items.cause: Temperature too low or not enough preheat time.
items.fix: The air fryer must be fully hot before the halloumi goes in. Cook at 200°C ,  lower temperatures produce a dry, pale result.

items.symptom: Melted and collapsed in the basket
items.cause: Halloumi substitute or wrong variety used.
items.fix: Not all white cheeses hold their shape. Use proper halloumi, not queso blanco or a similar soft cheese.

content.text: Halloumi fries are best eaten as they come out of the fryer as a quick starter or alongside a salad. Good with a dipping sauce ,  a spiced honey (honey + chilli flakes) or yoghurt with mint both work well. The same technique applies to a whole halloumi slice cooked for the same time.
